A.rule: Replay IF06 B2 on exact frozen source and preview matrices. Full recomputation for verified truncated pairs only; failed old geometry is not eligible for a distribution gate. Verify scalar metrics, homography and original prefix; missing or disagreement makes distribution unavailable. A1 changes distribution only; same B2 memory and other guards.

B.rule: One ledger per source, from frozen coarse candidates, SIFT, HSV, pair gray, independent local motion/photometry, old positive/uncertain temporal diagnostics. Remove HSV gate from SIFT observation, preserve old admissions and old memory reasons separately. Retain cross-edit appearance and temporal conflicts; suspected abrupt or failed quality only makes the pose hop unsuitable. No extra pair measurements across R arms.

R.context_rule: R0/R1 require two spaced, distinct wide source pairs of a candidate relation, order agrees, with two quality intermediate unfamiliar views for revisit. R2/R3 may also propose a route with at least one wide nonlocal pair plus independent local pose root paths whose forward composition closes to the direct match, at least two spatially separate candidate landmarks observed across halves, and no unexplained edit. Neither continuity nor a localized repeated object is sufficient. In every arm preserve time segments and selector; a qualified revisit changes at most one tentative hypothesis mapping with no graph union. Guard cross-span suspected edit or intermediate independently assigned appearance state for added pose route, while retaining match evidence. No negative room claims.

D.rule: Linear shortest circular angular prior on frozen R3, controlled only when true axes unavailable. Unknown remains unknown; zero/180/full turn/wrap and interval uncertainty checked; no hard different-space lower bound.

P2.rule: Keep P1 broad roles and budget. Add polarity-separated connected components on clean side temporal medians (at least 3 samples each), reject global/dense changes, jitter, valid measured displacement beyond cap, weak relative change, exposure on included sides; do not eliminate evidence for exposure outside compared states. Pquery uses fixed Cmax P0, allocates one strongest interior structural activity window inside accepted bracket and second nonoverlapping contrasting departure/arrival window, no labels; fallback original P0 windows. Do not combine arms.

stop: One lock; no parameter scans, no trained model, no Agent calls, no automatic media watcher. Unseen positive crossing/known pose absent unless found by snapshot. Report faults and unknown.
